No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Ideal six-cell meridional circulation framework retains six separate rectangular circulation loops, alternating lower-flow directions, rising-flow direction on each loop, upward height axis and rightward latitude axis with seven ordered stations. Loop width, inter-loop gaps and open arrowhead dimensions are independently laid out; stations are 13 mm ticks. Cell widths/heights do not give measured wind speed, pressure, literal rectangular air motion or a weather forecast. Loop width, inter-loop gaps and open arrowhead dimensions are independently laid out; stations are 13 mm ticks. Cell widths/heights do not give measured wind speed, pressure, literal rectangular air motion or a weather forecast. The external key assigns latitude and cell names.
